title: emailpush: update of another property re-validates untouched emailPush
description: validate.rs:447-450 + memory/push.rs:567-576: old is raw (unpruned) storage, new is pruned+patched, so old != new whenever an account was revoked; an expires-only update can fail on emailPush/A2/filter. -05 §4 errors apply only when "The change includes emailPush". Compare against the pruned old value. (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
close_reason: Fixed with regression tests (tests/email_query_filter.rs, emailpush_validate.rs, emailpush_deliver.rs).
